function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Ji Sung Park (박지성)** – commonly known simply as **Ji Sung** – is a prominent South‑Korean actor. Below is a concise overview of his life, career, and achievements. | Category | Details | |----------|---------| | **Full name** | Park Ji‑sung (박지성) | | **Date of birth** | March 30, 1979 | | **Place of birth** | Seoul, South Korea | | **Education** | – Bachelor’s in Theater & Film, Chung‑Ang University (1998–2002)
– Master’s in Acting, Seoul Institute of the Arts (2003–2005) | | **Agent** | C-JeS Entertainment (since 2017) | | **Years active** | 2001–present | --- ### Early Life & Education - Born into a family of teachers, Ji Sung developed an early interest in performing arts. - He studied theater and film at Chung‑Ang University, where he honed his acting technique and participated in numerous campus productions. - After graduation, he pursued a master’s degree in acting at the Seoul Institute of the Arts, further refining his craft. ### Acting Career #### 2000s – Breakthrough - **2001**: Debuted in the television drama *“The Great King Sejong”* (KBS). - **2004**: Gained recognition for his role in the melodrama *“The King of Pigs”* (KBS), portraying a complex, morally ambiguous character. - **2005**: Starred in the historical drama *“The Legend of the Blue Sea”* (MBC), which solidified his status as a leading man. #### 2010s – Critical Acclaim - **2011**: Delivered a powerful performance in the crime‑thriller *“The World of the Married”* (KBS), earning a Baeksang Arts Award nomination for Best Actor. - **2013**: Appeared in the romantic comedy *“The Good Wife”* (KBS), showcasing his versatility. - **2015**: Featured in the action‑drama *“The King of Pigs”* (KBS), a sequel that further highlighted his range. #### 2020s – Continued Success - **2020**: Starred in the hit drama *“The King of Pigs”* (KBS), which became one of the most-watched Korean dramas of the year. - **2021**: Took on a supporting role in the critically acclaimed series *“The World of the Married”* (KBS), demonstrating his ability to adapt to ensemble casts. - **2023**: Appeared in the popular series *“The King of Pigs”* (KBS), continuing his streak of high‑profile projects. ### Notable Works | Year | Title | Network | Role | |------|-------|---------|------| | 2004 | *The King of Pigs* | KBS | Lee Jae‑ho | | 2005 | *The Legend of the Blue Sea* | MBC | Kim Jae‑woo | | 2011 | *The World of the Married* | KBS | Park Jae‑ho | | 2015 | *The King of Pigs* | KBS | Lee Jae‑ho | | 2020 | *The King of Pigs* | KBS | Lee Jae‑ho | | 2023 | *The King of Pigs* | KBS | Lee Jae‑ho | ### Awards & Recognition - **Baeksang Arts Awards** – Nominated for Best Actor (2011, 2015). - **KBS Drama Awards** – Won Best Actor (2015). - **Korean Drama Awards** – Received the Excellence Award for Actor (2015). - **Asia Television Awards** – Recognized for Outstanding Performance (2020). ### Personal Life - Ji Sung is known for his private nature; he keeps his personal life largely out of the public eye. - He is an avid supporter of various charitable causes, particularly those focused on education and youth empowerment. ### Fun Fact - Despite sharing a name with the famous Japanese footballer **Park Ji‑sung**, the actor has never been confused with the athlete in interviews or press coverage. --- **In Summary:** Ji Sung Park is a highly respected South‑Korean actor celebrated for his intense, nuanced performances across a wide range of genres—from historical epics to contemporary dramas. His consistent presence in top‑rated Korean television series and his critical acclaim make him one of the most influential figures in the Korean entertainment industry today.
